# Organelle assets are generated by Blender scripts, one GLB per organelle

Models are built by Python Generators run headless in Blender 5.2 (the pipeline proven in ship-rpg: numpy-synthesised PBR textures, 3 LODs, meshopt/WebP GLB), not hand-modelled and not produced by AI image-to-3D services. One GLB per organelle, assembled in Three.js from Placement data, so Isolate, hide, click and Comparison need no extra work. If the Quality gate (M1) fails, we research alternatives (sculpting, local image-to-3D, cloud services, CC models) rather than ship weak assets.

Considered: procedural Three.js geometry only (rejected: texture richness cannot match the reference); one monolithic cell GLB (rejected: breaks per-organelle interaction); Tripo-style AI generation as in the reference project (kept as fallback only; licensing and reproducibility are weaker).
